definitions.explanation: A wheeled vehicle used for transporting goods, typically pulled by hand or by an animal.

examples.japanese: {牛|うし}が{荷車|にぐるま}を{引|ひ}いて{道|みち}を{進|すす}んだ。
examples.english: An ox pulled a cart along the road.

examples.japanese: {昔|むかし}の{農家|のうか}は{荷車|にぐるま}に{野菜|やさい}を{積|つ}んで{市場|いちば}まで{運|はこ}んでいた。
examples.english: In the old days, farmers loaded vegetables onto carts and transported them to the market.

notes:
{荷車|にぐるま} is a compound of {荷|に} (load, cargo) and {車|くるま} (vehicle, wheel). It refers to a simple wheeled vehicle for hauling goods.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {荷車|にぐるま}を{引|ひ}く (pull a cart)
- {荷車|にぐるま}に{積|つ}む (load onto a cart)
- {荷車|にぐるま}を{押|お}す (push a cart)

The word evokes a traditional or historical setting, as modern transportation has largely replaced carts. It appears frequently in historical fiction and descriptions of rural life.
